current_project_release.reason: Evidence organization is not historical first-availability/PIT, unit, state or execution certification.

use_tiers.allowed: Preserve originals and all outcomes including failed requests/rejected observations
use_tiers.required: Byte identity and explicit origin/observation time

use_tiers.allowed: Inspect coverage, field meaning, retrospective charts and source differences
use_tiers.required: Provenance + scope + units/status labels; no forecast performance claim

use_tiers.allowed: Only after a separate explicit feature/label protocol; compare data-version effects
use_tiers.required: Declared provider/vintage, unresolved flags, no use as untouched historical proof

use_tiers.allowed: Chronological forecasts using information genuinely known before decision
use_tiers.required: Certified event/knowledge time, version, causality-safe lags, split/purge protocol and independent holdout

use_tiers.allowed: Only with executable-order and complete cost evidence
use_tiers.required: Daily state, official reference/limits, order/lot/cash/settlement and account fees

temporal_contract.persisted_timestamps: ISO8601 with explicit timezone offset; UTC preferred for observation stamps
temporal_contract.naive_provider_clock: Keep raw; do not silently attach timezone or convert midnight date labels to exact releases.
temporal_contract.daily_bars: Final OHLCV cannot enter a decision before that same day closes and data is available. No speculative universal lag is imposed here.
temporal_contract.first_availability: A current retrieval proves availability now only; does not prove the same vintage existed on the historical date.
temporal_contract.historical_join: When released, select versions with certified earliest_model_use_timestamp <= decision_timestamp, and an explicit within-time correction policy. Period-end joins or unconditional forward-fill are forbidden.
temporal_contract.retrospective_fact: A later report may verify an earlier occurrence, but its later knowledge time remains later.
temporal_contract.calendar: A third-Friday formula candidate is not upgraded to verified occurrence merely because date has passed.

tri_state_contract.false_requires: Affirmative evidence supporting the negative predicate for the declared full scope.
tri_state_contract.unknown_requires: null plus missing_reason_code; may coexist with bounded positive or negative evidence.
tri_state_contract.admission_boolean: A false eligibility/certification gate is a decision/status about evidence, not a fact that trading was impossible or data was false.

missing_reason_assignment: A reason is an evidence-backed state, not a fill heuristic. For example NOT_YET_PUBLISHED requires proof that publication had not occurred by the decision time; unknown publication uses TIME_PRECISION_OR_FIRST_PUBLICATION_UNKNOWN. Multiple reasons may apply and should be stored as a linked set.

source_conflict_contract.key: symbol + event/trade date + field + price basis + unit/scope + source/vintage
source_conflict_contract.compare_only_if: Semantic field, time scope, units, adjustment basis and comparison precision are compatible.
source_conflict_contract.tolerance: Use an existing documented comparison rule without widening it to erase exceptions; no new research/decision threshold is created here.
source_conflict_contract.duplicate_handling: Identical content observations retain all request evidence. A declared deduplicated view may list support IDs; conflict creates separate versions, never multiple independent samples.
source_conflict_contract.adjudication: An explicit scoped reviewer decision may later choose a source, recording rationale and sensitivity; no provider is presumed ground truth here.
source_conflict_contract.index_volume: Blocked for pooled/spliced quantitative comparison until unit and coverage match.
source_conflict_contract.chip: Different initialization/load contexts retain separate observation versions; do not average to create a synthetic chip distribution.

units_and_adjustment.percent: percentage_points / 100 = fraction. Rates in fee_schedule are already fractions; do not divide by 100 again.
units_and_adjustment.stock_volume: SDK-explained hands *100 = shares; preserve unit certification status and raw precision. No index extrapolation.
units_and_adjustment.tencent_new_amount: raw row[8] *10000 = CNY according to inspected SDK mapping; row indices are zero-based.
units_and_adjustment.qfq_hfq: Price snapshot vintage, not historical point-in-time factor. Never label adjusted/unadjusted ratio an independently verified factor.
units_and_adjustment.capital: Reported unlimited shares != daily free-float denominator. Do not forward-fill period-end shares into turnover reconstruction.
units_and_adjustment.financial: Unit and consolidated/parent/YTD/quarter scope are per metric and per report. Preserve revisions and blank values.

cost_contract.inclusive_mode: Count verified all-in commission once. Add transfer only if known excluded, stamp tax only on applicable sale, and other genuinely excluded components once.
cost_contract.net_mode: Only if proven net commission: net brokerage + exchange + regulatory + transfer components not already included, with historical dates and account rounding/minimum.
cost_contract.unknown_mode: Do not add every candidate component mechanically. Preserve separate components and unknown package flags; do not output exact net result.
cost_contract.dividend_tax: Separate conditional event/holding tax calculation; do not assume zero or charge every trade a generic dividend tax.
cost_contract.project_operating_cost: Separate from transaction fees. May later be reported as operating expense and total project P&L without charging it again per trade.

feature_label_isolation.status: design_contract_only; no features or labels calculated

physical_layout_proposal.raw_observations: Read-only versioned source database; includes explicitly restricted provider outcome metadata.
physical_layout_proposal.features: Separate feature DB/files, whitelist-only columns, decision_timestamp, feature_window_end, max_certified_input_available_at, provenance and contract_version.
physical_layout_proposal.labels: Separate labels DB/files with outcome_start/end, horizon, maturity flag, future returns/path outcomes/cost assumptions. Feature builder receives no label path or connection.
physical_layout_proposal.training_join: Join only in evaluation/training pipeline after chronological split and maturity/purge rules are frozen; no labels/views attached during raw feature extraction.

feature_label_isolation.restricted_fields: Provider D1/D2/D3/D5/D10, CHANGE_RATE_nDAYS, RCHANGE3D/5D/10D and ambiguous forward fields remain quarantined pending exact semantics; confirmed future outputs belong only in labels.
statistical_boundaries: Do not call 915 dates 915 independent trades.
2022 prehistory is warmup, not outcome sample.
Duplicate sources and date roles do not expand effective sample.
No random time shuffle; chronological development/calibration/final test and overlapping-label purge remain a future protocol requirement.
No label that crosses a split boundary or is not mature at evaluation time.
